errors.evidence: The description fails to mention what the data represents, stating it is "some kind of data" (某种数据). The provided figure caption specifies that the chart shows the "Diachronic change in the standard deviation of the number of collocations" (搭配组数标准差的历时变化).
The description states the solid line drops to about 5 in 1958, but the value on the chart is clearly above 10 at that point.
The description incorrectly states that the peak of the dotted line is in 1956. The peak visibly occurs earlier, around 1952-1954.
